services.name: gateway
services.title: Gateway
services.desc: The one public entry point: HTTPS, token check, rate limits, and routing of /api/v1/<service>/* to the service behind it.

services.name: auth
services.title: Authentication service
services.desc: Accounts, sessions, two-step sign-in, Google sign-in, roles and tokens. Signs short-lived tokens and publishes its public keys. Nothing else.

services.name: notifications
services.title: Notification service
services.desc: Email, SMS, push and in-app notifications, sent when another service publishes notification.requested. Nothing else.

services.name: billing
services.title: Billing service
services.desc: Plans, features, seats, add-ons and the payment provider. Stores a subscription as entitlements. Checkout is off until a provider is chosen.

services.name: importing-lists
services.title: Importing lists (server)
services.desc: Feature 1: server-side list imports, column mapping and repeat merging for lists kept on the server.

services.name: skip-tracing
services.title: Skip tracing (server)
services.desc: Feature 2: server-side phone checks, Do Not Call, number lookups and network hints. Shares its rules with the shared service/ engine.

services.name: dialer-sms
services.title: Dialer, auto dialing and SMS
services.desc: Feature 3: calling, auto dialing, texting, number health, call logs and the carrier webhooks.

services.name: leads-map
services.title: Leads map
services.desc: Feature 4: exact locations, reverse lookups and nearby search for leads.

services.name: crm
services.title: The CRM
services.desc: Feature 5: leads, deals, tasks, handoffs, roles and reports. Owns offline sync for records the desktop edits.

services.name: ai-campaigns
services.title: AI campaigns
services.desc: Feature 6: email and text campaigns, AI writing, reply sorting and sending limits.

services.name: exports
services.title: Exports
services.desc: Feature 7: call lists, mail lists, whole-workspace exports and report files.

services.name: backup-restore
services.title: Backup and restore
services.desc: Feature 8: the recycle bin, point-in-time restore and workspace downloads.
